MDCW_HP_special_retire_SPR_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_hp_spr_special_retire_1 = 0 } }
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Adolfo Suarez"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/SPR_adolfo_suarez.dds"
			ideology = conservatism
			traits = { western_conservatism career_politician }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = do_not_retire }
			set_variable = { mdcw_hp_spr_special_retire_1 = 0 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { mdcw_hp_spr_special_retire_1 = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_hp_spr_special_retire_1 = 1 } }
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "José María Aznar"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/SPR/jose_maria_aznar.dds"
			ideology = conservatism
			traits = {
					western_conservatism
					lawyer
					career_politician
					silent_workhorse
				}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = do_not_retire }
			set_variable = { mdcw_hp_spr_special_retire_1 = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { mdcw_hp_spr_special_retire_1 = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Adolfo Suarez"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/SPR_adolfo_suarez.dds"
			ideology = conservatism
			traits = { western_conservatism career_politician }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = do_not_retire }
			set_variable = { mdcw_hp_spr_special_retire_1 = 0 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { mdcw_hp_spr_special_retire_1 = 1 }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_SPR_refresh_politics = yes
}

MDCW_HP_special_retire_USA_1 = {
	clr_country_flag = USA_1970_nixon_presidency
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_hp_usa_special_retire_1 = 0 } }
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Richard Nixon"
			picture = "gfx/Leaders/USA/USA_Coldwar_Nixon.dds"
			ideology = conservatism
			traits = { western_conservatism career_politician }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = do_not_retire }
			set_variable = { mdcw_hp_usa_special_retire_1 = 0 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { mdcw_hp_usa_special_retire_1 = 1 }
		}
		set_country_flag = USA_1970_nixon_presidency
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_hp_usa_special_retire_1 = 1 } }
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Gerald Ford"
			picture = "gfx/leaders/mdcw_historical_pool/USA_gerald_ford.dds"
			ideology = conservatism
			traits = { western_conservatism career_politician }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = do_not_retire }
			set_variable = { mdcw_hp_usa_special_retire_1 = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { mdcw_hp_usa_special_retire_1 = 2 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { mdcw_hp_usa_special_retire_1 = 2 } }
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Ronald Reagan"
			picture = "gfx/Leaders/USA/ronald.dds"
			ideology = conservatism
			traits = { western_conservatism career_politician }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = do_not_retire }
			set_variable = { mdcw_hp_usa_special_retire_1 = 2 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { mdcw_hp_usa_special_retire_1 = 0 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		create_country_leader = {
			name = "Richard Nixon"
			picture = "gfx/Leaders/USA/USA_Coldwar_Nixon.dds"
			ideology = conservatism
			traits = { western_conservatism career_politician }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = do_not_retire }
			set_variable = { mdcw_hp_usa_special_retire_1 = 0 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { mdcw_hp_usa_special_retire_1 = 1 }
		}
		set_country_flag = USA_1970_nixon_presidency
	}
}
